result_summary.title: Cohort Builder Outage and Restarts in LATAM
result_summary.description: The Cohort Builder is down in our LATAM production environment. We are seeing pods restarting repeatedly, causing a full outage for this feature. This impacts 49 users and has a moderate business impact. We need to get the Cohort Builder back online ASAP.
